complete_native_bootstrap.note: The complete patched source graph compiles and links. Its isolated single-site CLI bootstrap and all five runtime documents match original WordPress under PHP. Ordinary public build wall time includes source preparation and native dependency verification; it is not a compile-performance benchmark. The portable linker preserves allocated bytes and distinct function addresses. This does not prove full frontend, administration, authentication, networking or REST dispatch.

source_only_native_reproduction.note: An export containing only maintained source and the verified original archive reconstructed all files, passed PHP and native controls, rebuilt the complete bootstrap and matched original PHP. Its temporary export was removed.

complete_native_web.note: Live HTML rendered by the original WordPress bootstrap and SQLite-backed post APIs inside native HTTP requests.
